message.content: In Blackjack, an Ace is a “flexible” card—it can be worth **either 1 or 11 points**, whichever makes your hand stronger without causing you to bust. If counting it as 11 would push your total over 21, you automatically treat it as 1 instead. This dual value allows players to use Aces strategically to reach totals close to 21 while avoiding a bust.
